format: Word Jam Bus levels v4 (slide-until-blocked rules). Car {l, r, c, dir, len?}: (r,c) = HEAD cell, 1-indexed, body extends behind; l = letter, 2-letter chunk (e.g. "TH") or "?" wildcard. Level: word or words[], grid [rows, cols], bay, par (fewest moves; 1 move = 1 slide or exit; Bay Words included, boosters never), tip. Optional: tier ("starter" = beginner level; default "core"), mode ("scramble" = letters board in any order; default in order), teaches (the mechanic the level introduces), safe (no losing move exists). v7: a car may carry "key": colour and/or "lock": colour (gold, blue, pink); a padlocked car cannot move until the key car of its colour has left the lot.

levels.tip: Tap a car to drive it out the way its nose points. Letters board in order: C, A, T.
A blocked car still rolls forward until it bumps into something. Use that to clear a lane!
Swipe a car toward its tail (or right-click) to back it up. Cars only leave nose-first.
Wrong letter in the way? Drive it out: it waits in the holding bay and hops on when its turn comes.
A four-letter word! Work out which car is in the way of the F first.
The bay holds 3 now. If a wrong letter drives out while it is full, you lose!
Long trucks move as one piece and slide just like cars.
A busier lot. Back cars up to make room before you drive out.
Plan ahead: which letter can leave first, and what is blocking the next one?
Last warm-up! Next up: Main Street, with lots of ways to win.
Main Street! These lots have lots of ways to win: if one plan stalls, try another order.
Clear a lane first, then let the letters roll out.
Scramble stop: any order! Letters the word needs board right away. Only wrong letters and extra copies (like a third Z) wait in the junk bay.
Park a blocker in the bay only when you must: it holds 3.
Look for the letter that is almost free, and free it first.
Back a car up to open a path for the next letter.
Two C's: either C car can board first.
Long trucks block whole rows. Slide them out of the way.
Plan two moves ahead: what does each slide open up?
Six letters now. Keep the bay free for the end.
Main Street boss! Two T's and two E's give you choices.
Bigger lots from here on: mix slides, reverses and the bay to clear the way.
Stuck? Back a car up toward its tail to open a gap for another one.
Wrong letters wait in the bay and hop on when it is their turn. Only 3 spots!
Bay Word: three junk letters that spell a word (any order, like C-A-T) leave the bay for 10 bonus coins.
Any P car fills any P seat. Wiggle cars back and forth to open lanes.
Bigger lot, same tiny bay. Slide decoys aside instead of driving them out.
Plan ahead: one car's gap is another car's road.
Long trucks move as one piece. Back one up to free a whole lane.
The TH truck fills two seats at once.
Harbor Scramble stop: any order again. Can your junk letters spell a word?
Two stops: spell BUS, then STOP. The checkered ? taxi is a wildcard.
Final exam: a packed 7x7 lot. Free one gap at a time.
Padlocked cars can’t move until the key car of the same colour and shape drives out. Free the key first!
Scramble stop with a padlock: any order again, but the key still comes first.
One key opens every padlock of its colour.
Two colours, two keys: match the shapes (circle opens circle, triangle opens triangle).
Boss lot! A key car can be padlocked too: open the chain one key at a time.
